channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Commission holds special meeting March 4
item.description: Covington County commissioners held a special March 4 meeting to interview longtime public servant Jason Bryan for county comptroller; a hiring decision will be announced at a future meeting.

item.title: CCWJC to hold budgeting classes throughout March
item.description: Christian Women’s Job Corps will offer basic budgeting classes in Andalusia on March 16, 18, 23 and 25; participants receive worksheets and guidance on monthly personal budgets.

item.title: IMPOSSIBLE IS POSSIBLE WITH GOD’S HELP
item.description: From record-breaking miles to climbing Kilimanjaro without legs, this article uses real stories and Bible verses to show why Christians believe nothing is impossible with God.

item.title: Jail Report from March 3 to March 5
item.description: March 3–5 Covington County jail report lists multiple arrests on drug, harassment, domestic violence, sexual abuse, stalking and probation violation charges with bonds up to $100,000.

item.title: DHR to host Foster Parent Training
item.description: Covington County DHR will offer a free 10-week foster parent training course starting March 16 in Andalusia for residents interested in caring for children in foster care.

item.title: Bulldog Boosters announce Carnival
item.description: Andalusia Bulldog Boosters host first Community Carnival March 10–14 at the Kiwanis Center, featuring rides, food, games, and armband deals to support local sports.

item.title: AHS’ Memolusia to honor Powell
item.description: Andalusia High’s 2025-26 Memolusia yearbook will feature former AES art and music teacher Cathy Powell’s favorite floral painting on the cover, honoring her lasting impact.

item.title: Andy Rotary awards over $36,000 to local organizations
item.description: Andalusia Rotary Foundation awards over $36,000 to local schools, arts groups and charities, funded by its World Championship Domino Tournament returning July 12–13 for its 50th year.

item.title: STUDENTS GET SCHOOLED
item.description: Andalusia High’s FCCLA hosts a Feb. 20 student‑vs‑teacher basketball game, involving every grade to raise money for officer blazers as teachers win 60‑43.
